newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Two Swedish-based air freight forwarders to merge.
newsitem.headline: Two Swedish-based air freight forwarders to merge.

text.p: Two Swedish freight forwarders, Aerocar AB and Spedman AB, said on Tuesday they would merge to form a leading air, sea and trucking cargo company.
"The shareholders and boards of Aerocar AB and Spedman AB have decided to build a joint company for operations in Sweden," the two companies said in a joint statement.
"The new company, Aerocar Spedman, will operate a freight forwarding operation within air, sea and truck transport whose goal is to meet each customers specific need for quick transportation."
The new company is expected to have a turnover in 1997 of around 500 million crowns and will have about 120 staff.
"I think we will be number three or four in the market on the import and export side for air cargo," Aerocar chairman Kjell Hansson told Reuters.
"We complement each other very well because Spedman is 70 percent import and we are 70 percent export."
